blindSummary: Trans-inclusive anti-discrimination law, refuge/shield protections and mandated gender-care coverage sit alongside the second-highest killing rate of trans women recorded for any state/province in the country: 11.1 per 100k trans women/yr, including two Black trans women shot dead in this state/province's largest city ten weeks apart in 2026.
blindSourceSummaries: Data-driven essay (July 2026) arguing that legal-protection categories do not predict physical safety for trans women: overlaying a global trans-murder monitoring record (428 confirmed killings in this country 2008-2025, explicitly a floor) on the legislative risk map, this state/province sits in the strongest-protection legal group yet records 11.1 killings per 100k trans women per year - the second-highest state/province rate in the country, behind only a neighbouring state/province's 11.6; 90% of national victims were trans women or transfeminine.

Regional LGBTQ+ news blog (13 September 2026): two Black trans women were shot dead in this state/province's largest city ten weeks apart; the most recent, a 27-year-old, was found dying of multiple gunshot wounds in her neighbourhood on Friday 11 September 2026, with the suspect at large; the piece situates the killings within an undercounted wave of fatal violence against Black trans women.

Legal blog post on this state/province's gender-care coverage law (passed by the lower chamber 93-37, effective 1 January 2024): mandates public health-insurance coverage of gender-affirming treatment - hormones, puberty blockers and surgery - for an estimated 94,000 transgender and nonbinary state/province residents, placing care-access protections among the strongest legal layers in the country.
blindLocalsOnly: The gender-care coverage law's expansion of public health insurance covers gender-affirming treatment for the state/province's estimated 94,000 trans and nonbinary residents, according to a national trans-led legal-rights organisation's report - a care-access benefit a short-term visitor does not draw on.
